scope: Three original historical P2s in evidence/README section 7; source-only compatibility. Frozen R1 untouched.

cases.case: Equal-date observation and valid split dates
cases.expected: ACCEPT historical pool validation when each provenance source date is <= target/trade date, including equality. Keep signal/nested/source identity bindings. Do not add a strict D-1 rule or require eligibility date == price date.
cases.focused_acceptance: Both historical schemas: equality for each source-date field, both equal, and existing split fixture remain valid.

cases.expected: REJECT either eligibility_source_date or price_signal_date later than target, even when every nested date, source digest and run binding is otherwise consistent.
cases.focused_acceptance: One field future at a time for both schemas; use correctly bound payloads so the new upper-bound check is what rejects. Optional target_date absence still has trade_date as bound.

cases.expected: ACCEPT the existing valid timezone-bearing late capture in the historical store; retain HK_MODEL_SOURCE_PIT_AVAILABILITY_CANNOT_CONFIRM and false safety/natural flags. This gives no Stage/PIT acceptance.
cases.focused_acceptance: Original as-of fixture target 20260930 with capture 2026-10-02T14:02:56+08:00 passes unchanged. Invalid/naive timestamps still reject. Do not modify captured_at.

cases.case: Known nested required and optional fields
cases.expected: Preserve the current minimum required fields and valid optional fields in exact versioned eligibility_asof and price_recovery objects. Do not derive the full optional allowlist from the minimal fixture.
cases.focused_acceptance: Minimal original fixture must pass; any later supported allowlist must preserve full pinned producer/recovery examples and optional omissions. Implementation deferred because full schema/producer bytes are not supplied.

cases.expected: REJECT an unregistered key in either known versioned nested object. Preserve existing schema/version/date/SHA and false-flag checks.
cases.focused_acceptance: Deferred until complete schema inventory is supplied. Then insert unknown scalar, mapping and list keys into each versioned object independently; do not change the already-strict top-level contract.

cases.expected: ACCEPT arbitrary string source names in source_input_sha256; reject empty maps, non-string names and invalid/non-string digest values by the existing hash contract. Do not apply nested object-key allowlists to these data keys.
cases.focused_acceptance: At least two new source labels with valid digests pass; invalid digest/value/type still rejects. Preserve existing digest formats.

cases.expected: Keep generic v1 artifacts readable in their original wire shape; lineage fields remain optional. Absence does not prove historical PIT availability.
cases.focused_acceptance: Real-store readback equals original payload and artifact/receipt bytes; no injected provenance, capture time, source hash or flags. Existing legacy close-review metrics remain usable.

cases.case: Missing source evidence in close-review output
cases.expected: Use the existing uncertainty reason when historical_provenance is present OR, with provenance absent, either source_manifest_sha256 or source_receipt_sha256 is missing. Complete nonhistorical SHA pair keeps existing output.
cases.focused_acceptance: Both missing, each missing independently, complete pair, and historical branch. Marker appears once and survives real ReviewStore readback; unchanged scores, counts, status logic and false safety flags. No date-specific 20260825 branch.

cases.case: Exact absent-pool sentinel versus corrupt pool
cases.expected: Only FileNotFoundError with filename None and args exactly (hkconnect_d1_top100,) becomes a model-source gap. Other read/parse/contract errors propagate before review publication.
cases.focused_acceptance: Exact absent pool retains MODEL_0_2_SOURCE_MISSING and 0 model rows plus uncertainty; missing manifest/receipt, bad JSON, wrong receipt or provenance errors never become an empty successful model.

cases.case: Preserve source artifact, receipt and manifest
cases.expected: Validation and close-review generation do not rewrite source pool bytes, its receipt or its manifest entry. Rejecting a newly disallowed existing artifact leaves the historical evidence intact.
cases.focused_acceptance: Hash source trio before/after successful reads, marker generation and rejection. Existing idempotent materialization/conflict behavior remains. No recovery or backfill call introduced.

cases.expected: The unchanged explicit ReviewStore publication path may create or supersede a synthetic review under its existing expected-SHA contract; it does not authorize rerunning or overwriting actual historical outputs.
cases.focused_acceptance: Marker persists after publication; current review readback/errors and expected-SHA behavior remain unchanged. Do not require a new publication/store schema or broad archival redesign for this P2.

cases.expected: Source/test results can demonstrate the missing-evidence class, not restore Aug25/Sep30/Oct7 data or verify natural/PIT execution. Stage validation stays unchanged.
cases.focused_acceptance: Report all actual data, current-owner integration, Mac, Stage canary, API/UI and natural execution as NOT_RUN/CANNOT_CONFIRM; preserve frozen R1.

known_nested_fields.inventory_status: The two supplied recovery tests do not define the nested objects. test_hk_expected_missing_recovery.py:22-33 points to external Mac ACTIVE_BINDINGS, source archive and local_fix/roots/shared_package. No complete schema inventory is established; keep the unknown-field P2 unresolved rather than apply a fixture-only allowlist.
